entries.zh: 柔软、细嫩；（丝线、毛发等）纠结缠绕成团，纠缠不清
entries.en: soft, tender; tangled and knotted (of thread or hair); muddled, entangled
entries.notes: H 作「嫩」与 L「cosa marañada」（纠结之物）义不完全相合，M 两读 lūn/jūn 未定，四栏折中定此二义。

entries.zh: 绊住、缠住（脚）；被牵连陷入
entries.en: to trip up, to entangle the feet; ensnared, caught up in
entries.notes: L 有 [疑:o ono] 校读、H 有 絆/詳 之疑，M 两读为文白异读，义从「絆」定。

entries.zh: 头发松散蓬乱，发散未束
entries.en: with hair loose and dishevelled; hair let down
entries.notes: L「rebuelto de compuesto」费解，依 H「髮 鬆」与 M pūn-lông 定。

entries.en: confused and clamorous; a jumble of noise
rebellion, turmoil; the land in unrest

entries.zh: 波涛翻腾、水势汹涌；（喻）纷乱无秩序
entries.en: rough and churning (sea); disordered, in confusion
entries.notes: H 作「波逃」，据 M pō-tô 与 L「rebuelto」（水势翻腾）判为「波濤」之借写。

entries.zh: 混乱糊涂；混帐、胡闹（责骂语）
entries.en: muddled, confounded; rascally, absurd (a term of abuse)
to bray; to bellow, to shout
entries.notes: L 拼写存疑（Rebuñar/Rebuznar），H「吼」与 M hàu 均指大声叫吼。

entries.en: to relapse (into illness), to fall ill again
entries.notes: H/M/R 三栏全空，仅凭 L「Recaer...enfermedad」立义，无土语对证。

entries.zh: 谨慎自省、言行检点；端庄守礼
entries.notes: H「省」取省察、检点义，非「省俭」义。

entries.zh: 性情和顺、循规蹈矩（指人）
entries.notes: H 栏空，M hō-sèng 疑为「好性」，仅据 L 与音写推。

entries.zh: 矛（枪）尾端的铁镦、铁尖；锥尖
entries.en: the butt-spike (ferrule) of a lance; the point of an awl

entries.zh: （有节制地）念诵、吟唱；言语有分寸
entries.en: to recite or chant (prayers) in measured fashion; to speak with restraint
entries.notes: L 中 comediendo 已被划除、R 栏淡墨残缺，正条义依 H「念 吟」与 M 定，末一义存疑。

entries.en: to mutter prayers, to pray under one's breath

entries.zh: （不解其义地）念诵、唱诵书文经句
entries.en: to chant and gabble (texts, prayers) without understanding
entries.notes: M 末段被墨笔涂去，L 跨行连写「chablar sin entender」，义据 H「念 書 歌」定。

entries.en: to read the scriptures from the book

entries.notes: M 栏末混入西语 recar.，系原稿衍写，不影响释义。

entries.zh: 轮流（依次）诵经；宣唱经文
entries.en: to recite the scriptures in turn; to intone aloud
entries.notes: M 首音节声调符号污损（T99），L「en torno」取轮次义。
